name: Basic Waffles
description: This is a basic recipe for waffles that are made with the help of a waffle maker :

ingredients.name: Vanilla sugar or other vanilla flavouring
ingredients.originalText: 2 pcks vanilla sugar (16g) or other vanilla flavouring

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 250g butter; 200g sugar; 2 pcks vanilla sugar (16g) or other vanilla flavouring; 5 eggs; 500g flour; 2 tbsp baking powder; 350-400ml milk. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Gradually add all the sugar and the vanilla flavouring.
Melt and then mix in the butter.
Add the milk and flower in alternation.
Blend and mix until you got a smooth dough.
Use the highest speed of your mixer.
Let the dough rest for a couple of minutes.
Turn on & preheat your waffle maker, then pour in the dough.
Bake inside the waffle maker till golden brown.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Logianer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the eggs till creamy.
2. Gradually add all the sugar and the vanilla flavouring.
3. Melt and then mix in the butter.
4. Add the baking powder.
5. Add the milk and flower in alternation. Stir constantly while doing so.
6. Blend and mix until you got a smooth dough. Use the highest speed of your mixer.
7. Let the dough rest for a couple of minutes. Turn on & preheat your waffle maker, then pour in the dough. Bake inside the waffle maker till golden brown.
8. Enjoy!
